summary: Itau Unibanco filed a Form 6-K furnishing its 1Q26 earnings review presentation. The filing highlights recurring managerial results of R$12.3 billion, a credit portfolio of R$1,483 billion, and a CET1 ratio of 12.0%. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other special situation is announced. The document is a routine quarterly earnings update. As a foreign private issuer, the 6-K is equivalent to a US earnings press release. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, or transaction mechanics to analyze. No risk-arb angle applies.
